entry.title: Idle Loops v0.4.2
entry.content:
## Idle Loops AP 0.4.2 ## #### "I have no control over the versioning scheme i chose this is a major release despite being versioned as a patch" ####
### APWorld: ### - Rewrote everything for options, and as such: - Options! - Toggles for location types - Set max level per location type - Goal based defaults (That are reasonable and playtested this time!) - (Probably should have been presets) - You can assume the new features below also have options to enable/disable them. - Added "Mana Logic" for Z1, i.e. AP knows exactly (well, underestimates) how much mana/gold you can get and what locations are possible - This let me turn off the heavy handed previous logic and now playthroughs of Z1 actually feel different! - Added a "Shop" to Z1/3 to buy checks for ramping gold costs - Respect Vanilla skill requirements for actions (i.e. Heal The Sick's "Unlocked at 12 Magic") - Unsupported additional option to also respect progress bar requirements, it's all implemented and working i just don't want complaints about Fill Errors or how close to vanilla it feels - Make Mana Reduction actions a requirement for what they reduce - Logically guarantee 10k mana from Z1 into Z2 - Require Glasses to be in Z1 - Add a second Glasses to the pool (you start the loop with Glasses if you have both) - Batch Wild Mana and Herbs 10x - Added a "Nothing" filler item - Added Gamespeed, Stat Exp and Skill Exp mults, both global and as items. (No skill exp item it would feel bad to spend time leveling something then get an item that would have sped it up by 10%) - Generally improved logic all around
### Client: ### - Also rewrote everything but for no reason - That's a lie things are properly laid out now i have a build process and everything - Colourful message log - Corrected colours on Lloyd's fork's dark mode so these colours align with other AP clients and Strength is Red again. - Redid scouting properly (compared to the very minimal original), largely a code difference but they're colourful now (and are placed in every relevant tooltip) - This feels like retreading the above but did your eyes gloss over 'Added a "Shop"'? That needed me to figure out how to inject actions into the game! - Another thing that would have been way easier if i forked the game rather than a client mod. - Added a tooltip to the "AP log" title displaying received non-action items - Fixed starting items not having an effect the first loop after connecting
And a whole lot of internal changes, optimizations and improvements (as implied by rewriting everything) that aren't really user facing so i didn't want to turn them into a patch note.

entry.title: Refunct v1.3.1
entry.content:
## Co-op! - In the yaml and in in-game settings, you can enable seeing other players. If other players in the multiworld have this setting on too, you can see them walking around in your game! - The option is called "see other players" and it determines how many other players you can see in your game. Setting it to 0 turns it off. I think 10 players at a time should be fine performance-wise. - (Technical: packets are only sent to Refunct slots with the setting on, at max 1 per second. The send-rate slowly decreases with the number of players, making it so there are never more than 10 packets per second in total for this in the end (which only occurs if there are 10+ players).) - You can now connect to the same slot as someone else, and buttons/platforms/cubes in the main gamemode will be synced! You will also still be able to see each-other.
### Mod: - Starting from v1.3.1 generated games, you can only join games with the *exact* correct mod version. If you log in with another version, the mod will show which version you need (bottom-left and top-right). All previous versions are available in the releases tab.
### Options & Gameplay: - Added "Ascend" trap. ☁️ - Added "Depthless trap". 🙈 - Added option to have only gameplay-traps.
### Fixes: - Go-mode in UT now shows correctly. If you have enough grass and (one of the following) - if your goal is known and you can reach it. - if your goal is unknown and you have been to your final location. - When connecting, it now shows that it is still connecting instead of pretending it worked. - Removed a jump from logic that was very tight (22-1 -> 22-2).

entry.title: Divinity Original Sin 2 v0.7.0
entry.content:
New: - A new class named "Random" has been added. Origin party members can also be given the Random class by saying your interested in someone with some randomness when recruiting them. - This class will start with three (or five if recruiting a companion past act 1) random starter skills as well as a random race skill and random origin source skill. - These skill have a bit of logic to them, so you cannot get a skill that requires a ranged weapon and another skill that requires a melee weapon at the same time, or incarnate infusions without the incarnate itself. - This class also comes with the additional setting to expand the selection of skill from starter skill to all non-source skills. You will get all the combat ability points needed to use every ability. - Traps are now bespoke, so the old random status traps have been replaced with something like "Minor Poison Trap" or "Severe Cow Trap". - A new option "Enable Level Teleport" has been added, which when enabled, will give you a "Level Teleport" item when loading into the Merryweather. - This item will allow you to teleport to any region you have been to before. - This item is still in beta and is very unstable, it is recommended to save before using it and to reload said save after you are done using it. - Two new client commands have been added, "/directory" and "/hits". - "/directory" will display the the directory the client have saved and its contents. This is mainly to help with troubleshooting if you come to me for help. - "/hits" will display the remaining hits needed for victory on hit list goals.
Changes/Bugfixes: - Tremendous thanks to @/rentashayanvi, @/swagalicous, and @/raptor980 for reporting and helping with many of these changes and bugs. - The client no longer crashes when the wrong directory is selected and will now exit gracefully and prompt you again on next open. - Quests will now not close on act exit, you will have to complete them properly. - "The Taming of the Holy Fire" no longer needs the Scholar tag to be deciphered. - "Driftwood: Dessicated Undead (490, 828)" and the corresponding "Lich" hit list objective has been removed as it is missable. - The Kraken in the Arx harbor has been added as a check and hit list objective. - Remaining hits will no longer be printed to the client on connect and hit complete, use "/hits" instead. - The region "Fort Joy" has been split in two, "Fort Joy Ghetto" and "Fort Joy". - "Fort Joy Ghetto" encapsulates the beach and its namesake, while "Fort Joy" encapsulates the fort itself and the prison beneath it. - The fire slugs in the Fort Joy Prison have been added as checks. - "East Reaper's Eye" has been renamed to "The Hollow Marshes". - The ad Trompdoys that are apart of the second fight against Trompdoy are now checks. - The Small Viscous Eggs found during Counting your Chickens are now checks. - The ads in Mordus' fight are now checks. - The Viscous Eggs found in Wreckers Cave are now checks. - White Magister Jonathan is now a check - The two magisters fighting voidwoken in the entrance to The Blackpits are no longer checks. - The magisters preparing to execute the Crossleys now share a check with each member of the Crossleys, so letting the execution occur will no longer make missable checks. - Owen Anchoret now shares a check with the Magister Inquisitor during No Way Out while the other magisters included in that quest are no longer checks. This makes it so no matter how you treat that quest, you will not create missables. - The gate guards in The Blackpits are no longer checks. - Magister Reimond is no longer a check, as he can flee the fight in The Blackpits and become missable. - The ads in Ghalann's fight are now checks (except for one that he summons). - The ads in Ryker's fight are now checks. There are three masked servants in each arena you can fight him in and they share a check with each other so no matter where you fight Ryker, you can't miss a check. - The Captains Hideaway's containers are now checks if containersanity is enabled. - Various absent container checks in the Lady Vengeance have been added. - The crate covering the ladder to the inside of the Merryweather that the Kraken destroys is no longer a check. - A pile of body parts in the magister prison by the source hounds is no longer a check. - An unlootable tree stump in the Fort Joy Beach is no longer a check. - The Illusionary Crates in Trompdoy's cave are no longer checks. - Rakeda's cave's containers have been reevaluated, with some removed and some added, shouldn't have any unreachable containers anymore (I hope). - A barrel in The Blackpits cave that could only be destroyed, not looted, is no longer a check. - Two piles of corpses that change when spirit vision is used by them in Bloodmoon Island are no longer checks. - A skeleton in Bloodmoon Island has been added as a container check. - Before uncompleteable quest "The Voices" is no longer a check. - Delusions of Gradeur has been corrected to Delusions of Greatness. - Crippling a Demon is no longer a check. - Mordus' basement is now logically in Reaper's Bluffs. - Lamenting Abomination and Alice Alisceon are in logic at level 14 (was 12). - The Shadowcloak's in the Paladin Checkpoint are now logically in The Blackpits. - The harbor building in The Blackpits are now in logic at level 16 and when you can get source vampirism (was level 15). - The area around the quest "They Shall Not Pass" up to the gate into stonegarden and he waterfall into Ryker's basement are now logically in Reaper's Coast. - The fight against Loic the Immaculate is now in logic at level 20 (was 19) - The ads in the Kraken fight and surrounding area are now in logic at level 20 (was 19) - The quest "The Shreikers" are now in logic after getting a purging wand and being level 9 (was 7) - The quest "Red Ink in the Ledger" is now logically in Reaper's Bluffs. - The quest "The Gift of the Blackroot" is now logically in Cloisterwood. - The quest "Hammerfall" is now logically in the Tomb of Lucian. - The quest "A Taste of Freedom" is now logically in Cloisterwood. - The quest "The Wrecked Caravan" is now logically in Driftwood. - The quests "Shadow over Driftwood", "Drowning Her Sorrows", and "The Law of the Order" are now logically in Reaper's Bluffs. - The quests "Waking Ryker", "Hannag's Bargin", "A Generous Offer", "Heroes' Rest", "The Reluctant Servants", "Dark Dealings in the Blackpits", and "Almira's Request" are now logically in The Blackpits. - Ryker and his ads are now logically in The Blackpits. - The quests "Jahan's Lesson", "All In The Family", and "A Hunter of Wicked Things" are now logically in Bloodmoon Island. - The quest "Keep Calm and Carrion" now are in logic at level 15 (was 11). - The quests "Wisdom of the Keeper/The Righteous", and "Past Mistakes" along with Karon and his ads are now logically in the Tomb of Lucian. - The hit list goal will now be in logic when the final hit target is in logic (was incorrectly placed in Fort Joy before). - Several typos were fixed.
Setup Guide [here](https://github.com/Intaiachi/ArchipelagoDOS2/blob/main/worlds/dos2/docs/steup_en.md)
DOS2 mod pak file [Github](https://github.com/Intaiachi/DOS2-Archipelago-Mod/releases), [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3741893354)

entry.title: Refunct v1.3.2
entry.content:
## Co-op! - In the yaml and in in-game settings, you can enable seeing other players. If other players in the multiworld have this setting on too, you can see them walking around in your game! - The option is called "see other players" and it determines how many other players you can see in your game. Setting it to 0 turns it off. I think 10 players at a time should be fine performance-wise. - (Technical: packets are only sent to Refunct slots with the setting on, at max 1 per second. The send-rate slowly decreases with the number of players, making it so there are never more than 10 packets per second in total for this in the end (which only occurs if there are 10+ players).) - You can now connect to the same slot as someone else, and buttons/platforms/cubes in the main gamemode will be synced! You will also still be able to see each-other.
### Mod: - Starting from v1.3.0 generated games, you can only join games with the *exact* correct mod version. If you log in with another version, the mod will show which version you need (bottom-left and top-right). All previous versions are available in the releases tab. - You can now press CTRL+P to enter the practice tool for speedruns. Might find a better way to reach that soon.
### Options & Gameplay: - You can now choose which effects and traps you want. ⚠️ yaml has changed quite a bit⚠️ - Added "Ascend" trap. ☁️ - Added "Depthless trap". 🙈 - Pretty traps are now "effects" and are just filler items instead of traps.
### Fixes: - Go-mode in UT now shows correctly. If you have enough grass and (one of the following) - if your goal is known and you can reach it. - if your goal is unknown and you have been to your final location. - When connecting, it now shows that it is still connecting instead of pretending it worked. - Removed a jump from logic that was very tight (22-1 -> 22-2). - Added a jump to logic because it is very easy with ledge grab (3-3 -> 3-4)

entry.title: Mario Sports Mix v2.2.0
entry.content:
## What's Changed? - **Exhibition Tour:** `find_num_exhibition_locs` was called with the wrong number of arguments in `locations.py`; the helper now consistently receives `enabled_sports`, `exhibition_type`, and `exhibition_difficulties`. - **Universal Exhibition:** Generation now requires at least one enabled main sport, so Sports Mix alone can no longer create impossible universal exhibition checks. - **Universal Exhibition:** Fixed `FillError` when Universal Exhibitions were enabled with no main sports. - **Exhibition Checks:** Now only generate when at least one main sport is enabled. - **Cup/Exhibition Access:** `can_play_any_cup`/`can_play_any_exhibition` now use actual generated match locations and no longer index an empty court list. - **Character/Special Sanity:** These checks can now be satisfied by any real generated tournament, exhibition, or Party Mode match. - **Court Sanity:** Checks are now created only for courts playable in the current configuration; empty exhibition difficulties no longer create phantom court checks. - **Court Sanity Access:** Now based on actual generated match locations, so Progressive Court and Progressive Cup configurations are handled correctly. - **Behemoth Rules:** Rule construction is now safe when no main sport is enabled, removing an empty-list `[0]` access. - **Boss Location:** Validation now includes the 'both' option when tournaments are disabled. - **Behemoth Config:** Configurations with no main sport enabled are now rejected early. - **Exhibition Tour Config:** Now validates All Sports type, at least one difficulty, and at least one main sport. - **Win Cups:** Now validates against the actual number of cups available for enabled sports/difficulties - **Character/Special Sanity Config:** Configurations with no playable match mode are now rejected early instead of becoming unreachable FillErrors. - **Unlock Items:** Removed unnecessary cup, court, and exhibition unlock items when no matching content exists. - **Party Palooza:** Party Palooza-only seeds can now generate correctly. - **Filler Handling:** Fixed rapid fire filler replacement
NOTE: This release is only classed as compatible with itself in the client due to the large changelog, but it *should* hopefully be fine with existing multiworlds. If you want new features I'd recommend waiting for the 3.0.0 release.

entry.title: zoominoes v0.1.0.post4
entry.content:
Community testing build. Feedback and bug reports welcome.
## Install
**1. BepInEx** — download **BepInEx 6 bleeding-edge, `Unity.Mono`, `win-x64`** from <https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be> and unzip it into the game folder, next to `Zoominoes.exe`. Zoominoes is a Unity 6 Mono game; BepInEx 5 will not work. Run the game once so BepInEx creates its folders, then close it.
e.g. for Windows: <https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/785/BepInEx-Unity.Mono-win-x64-6.0.0-be.785%2B6abdba4.zip>
**2. The mod** — unzip `ZoominoesArchipelago.zip` into the same game folder. It drops into `BepInEx/plugins/`.
**3. The world** — put `zoominoes.apworld` in your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` folder.
On Linux the game runs under Proton with the same files. Add `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command%` to the Steam launch options, or the loader will not inject.
## Playing
Press **F1** for the connection panel, enter your server address, port, slot name and password, and connect. The panel opens by itself until you do. Details are remembered for next launch.
Runs are played on a dedicated **AP** profile. Your existing saves are not read or written while the mod is installed.
## What is randomised
Animals, snacks, souvenirs, zookeepers and difficulty tiers arrive as Archipelago items, along with extra starting gold, extra plays and hand size.
`randomize_starter_zookeeper` and `randomize_starter_unlocks` extend that to what you open with: a random zookeeper in place of Marina, and a random 6 animals, 4 snacks and 4 souvenirs in place of Starfish, Fennec and the rest. Whatever the draw passes over becomes an item like anything else.
Checks come from Gift Shop slots and from finishing a day. **Every difficulty tier has its own set of both** — "Tier 3 - Shop 2 - Slot 1" is a different location from "Tier 5 - Shop 2 - Slot 1", so each tier you unlock opens 43 fresh checks: 24 across its eight shops and 19 across its playable days. On top of that, winning with each zookeeper and clearing each tier are checks in their own right.
Three goals: clear a target difficulty tier, clear it with several different zookeepers, or collect Zoo Tickets scattered across the multiworld.
Only normal runs take part — daily challenges, seeded runs and challenge runs are left alone.
Items apply from your **next** run, since the game fixes its content pool when a run begins.
## Options
`Zoominoes-template.yaml` has every option, its documentation and its weights. Put it in your Archipelago `Players` folder and change the name at the top.
Content the seed has no room for is unlocked from the start rather than left unobtainable.

entry.title: Haste v0.5.0
entry.content:
The fifth major release of the Haste Archipelago
You will need to subscribe to and enable the [Mod](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3462307025) on Steam.
## New YAML Features - **Disaster Shards** are now supported, acting as Shards 11-14 in the Shard Goal setting - **Starting Shard** allows you to choose which Shard your checks begin in, removing locations in all previous Shards - When playing with Progressive Speed Upgrades, you will be pre-given enough of them to keep up with your Starting Shard - All hub purchases will still expect 1 *additional* Progressive Shard before being logically available - **Dynamic Scaling** for both Shopsanity and Fragmentsanity, which sets the checks in each Shard relative to the length of the Shard itself - The length of each Shard can be found [here](https://github.com/WritingHusky/haste_apworld/blob/main/docs/ShardLengths.md) - **Global Shop Packs** can be added to hard-lock later Global Shopsanity purchases, segmented into blocks of 15 purchases - An additional setting to add extra Packs has also been added - Quality of Life options - **Refund Bad Purchases** will refund you any Sparks spent on *AP Shop Items* that would not send a check. This setting does nothing if you do not have Shopsanity Separate enabled. - **Remove Separate AP Shop Items When Done** will prevent *AP Shop Items* from appearing in Shops once you have exceeded the available checks in that region (either through completely running out, or lacking sufficient Global Shop Packs) - **Scout Hub Locations** enabled all hub purchases to also send AP hints upon opening their respective NPC's dialogue - This setting can be overridden at any time via the in-game options menu. - Anti-Quality of Life option - **Base Disaster Level** will *permanently* set all Shards to have the corresponding Disaster Shard effects - This setting is provided ***WITHOUT ANY SAFEGUARDING LOGIC***. Do NOT enable unless you know what you are doing. - This base Disaster level *will* stack with any Disaster Traps, but will *not* stack with the normal Disaster Shards
## Logic Changes - The Crispy and Twister Flopsy costume purchases have been moved out of Vanilla Plus and into Vanilla, since the Disaster Shards that lock them are now accessible - Expensive Captain's Upgrade and Fashion Weeboh Purchases will require additional Progressive Shards before becoming logically available - Captain's Upgrades: - Purchase 1-2: No additional Shards - Purchase 3-4: 2 additional Shards - Purchase 5: 4 additional Shards - Purchase 6: 6 additional Shards - EXCEPTION: The first and only 'Max Lives' Upgrade purchase expects 2 additional Shards, as it is the same price as Purchase 4 in other upgrade lines - Costume Purchases: - Flopsy and Weeboh: 2 additional Shards - Zoe 64, Twisted Flopsy, and Totally Accurate Zoe: 4 additional Shards
## Bugfixes - Fixed Courier's Board not being considered a valid Ability to access Shards 5 & beyond - Fixed Wraith's Hourglass and Sage's Cowl having swapped IDs in some places, which lead to weird fill errors with the Totally Accurate Zoe costume purchase - Fixed issue where Little Sister and Supersonic Zoe costumes were not being locked properly in Vanilla Plus and All Unlocks - Fixed issue where "Seperate" was used several times instead of "Separate", which is how the word is actually spelled

entry.title: pokemon_stadium v0.8.0
entry.content:
## Reworked move balancing
### The goal of this reworked system is to recreate the difficulty curve of the vanilla game as closely as possible so that players have a sense of progression as they work through a seed
- Removed old system that had 3 different tier systems for physical, special, and status moves - All moves combined into a single tier system now - Assigned "BST modifiers" to each tier. These are used to calculate an "adjusted BST" for each Pokémon - Calculated vanilla adjusted BSTs to and compiled a list of target BSTs for each gym/cup - These target BSTs will get a setting in a later update to allow them to be shuffled - Randomizer now builds movesets for Pokémon that align them with a target BST - Rental lists are sorted by adjusted BST - The later in the rental table a Pokémon appears, the stronger it should be
Also fixed the naming for Poké Cup trainer locations.
